notes: Variant assumption is a standing cable rope face pull pulled to eye or forehead height with the hands separating beside the face and a mild external-rotation finish. No peer-reviewed exact face-pull EMG study was found, so classification uses close high-abduction cable row, posterior-deltoid rear-shoulder exercise, trapezius horizontal-abduction, and pulley external-rotation evidence. Infraspinatus, teres minor, and upper trapezius are not listed as individual visible muscles because local anatomy exposes a rotator cuff aggregate and trapezius aggregates rather than those exact labels.
